I am a Ph.D. candidate in Economics at Brown University and a member of the [Global Linkages Lab](https://www.globallinkages.org). Currently, I am visiting the Federal Reserve Board of Governors as a Dissertation Fellow for the summer of 2026.

My interests are in macroeconomics, international finance, and macro-finance.
In particular, I study risk and uncertainty and their implications for the macroeconomy and financial markets.

:::{.callout-important}
## 2026-2027 Job Market
I will be on the 2026-2027 academic job market.
My job market paper, **"Source Matters: Demand vs. Supply Uncertainty in a Small Open Economy,"** can be found [here](research/work-in-progress/2026-05-15-Domestic-Uncertainty/index.qmd).
:::
